hook.name: EquityLaunchHook
hook.description: Bonding-curve launchpad hook for pools quoted in tokenized stock shares (Robinhood Chain Stock Tokens). Captures trading fees entirely on the quote side via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas, routing them through a FeeRouter (protocol/creator/referrer split). Three phases: a 50-block anti-sniper guard (90%→3% fee decay), a 1% bonding-curve phase, and a 1% graduated phase triggered by a per-pool quote raise threshold.
